settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Change how Lumen backs up, how fast it runs, and how it looks.
settings.paletteStyleSubtitle: Select how colorful or vibrant your theme appears.

settings.backupThreadsSubtitle: Set how many files back up at the same time.
settings.speedLimitSubtitle: Limit backup speed so other devices on your network stay fast.
settings.proxyUrlSubtitle: Route your backups through an HTTP or SOCKS5 proxy server.
settings.minimizeToTraySubtitle: Keep Lumen running in the system tray when you close the window.
settings.trayNotSupported: System tray is not supported on this desktop.
settings.launchOnStartupSubtitle: Automatically start Lumen in the background when your computer turns on.
settings.desktopNotificationsSubtitle: Get a notification on your desktop when backups finish.
settings.quietHoursSubtitle: Only automatically back up between scheduled hours
settings.quietHoursScheduleSubtitle: Only allow background backups during specific hours of the day.
settings.pauseOnBatterySubtitle: Temporarily pause background uploads when running on battery to conserve power.
settings.deleteFromHostSubtitle: Delete local photos from your computer once they're backed up.

settings.deleteConfirmP2: This won't touch anything you backed up previously, and your photos in Google Photos stay safe. You won't be able to recover the deleted files from your computer.

circuitBreaker.signInRequiredDesc: Google is asking you to sign in again. Backups are paused to protect your account.
circuitBreaker.accountRestrictedDesc: Google has restricted this account. Backups are stopped. Check your Google account directly; do not keep retrying.
circuitBreaker.rateLimitedDesc: Google asked Lumen to slow down. Rate limit expires in {time}.

circuitBreaker.safetyModalL2: Backs off automatically on temporary errors so requests don't spam Google's servers.
circuitBreaker.safetyModalL3: Keep a local copy of important photos—don't rely on one app as your only backup.
